title: 343 人形战术核弹342 力量数值超三万
content_zh:
清理完第四营，曹笔第一时间回到了总兵府的西偏院，坐镇其中，谨防有可能出现的意外。
经历了两次的肃清行动，他已经意识到一个问题。
许总兵与卞参将对他而言，不仅仅是追随者，更像两个效率放大器。
借助他们的头脑和手中的权力，可以节省很多的事情。
将刀疤女放到床上，盖好被子后，曹笔来到桌子旁，不急不忙地为自己斟了一杯茶，缓缓坐下，闭目细品。
一边品，一边查看全新的属性面板。
【姓名：曹笔】
【力量：39333.7】
【速度：23887.3】
【体质：24807.7】
【感知：7133.3】
【精神：6707.7】
【怨念：601】
【戾气：312.7】
【死气：718】
【噬灵：70】
【执念：88】
【特殊：操土控石】
【特殊：舔花游龙舌技】
【稀有：锤子与镰刀：1（未知倒计时）】

“偏科真严重啊！”
“按照这个趋势发展下去，以后真成纯莽夫了！”
意识到自己的力量属性独领风骚，曹笔感慨不已。
不过，他也没办法，杀人之后，他已经尽量在掠夺其它属性了。
可是，这个世界的人，绝大多数，也是偏科严重的存在。
一般而言，力量偏上，尤其是凶骨人。
其次是体质和速度，居中。
最后才是感知和灵魂，这两个尤其弱。
哪怕是特别营的边军精锐，也是如此。
绝大多数时候，精神数值都不会超过一。
曹笔也不知道是他们逛窑子逛多了，还是自己撸多了，反正，孔武有力的躯体下，精神力惨不忍睹。
至于那些普通的流民，更加不堪，许多连力量都达不到标准一，就更别说感知与精神了。
为了保持最大的性价比，当被杀目标所有属性都低于一的时候，曹笔会毫不犹豫地选择感知或者精神。
当目标的力量，速度，与体质三项属性远大于感知与精神的时候，曹笔会优先选择最大值那个。
在这种抉择方法下，不知不觉就变成了偏科生。
“谦虚谨慎，戒骄戒躁！
前路漫漫，还需要再接再厉！”
看着力量属性那一栏，曹笔的脑海中突然浮现出了三张巨型狼人的面貌，喜悦的心情，瞬间减半。
回想起自己当初那两击先手，他有种莫名的紧迫感和压力。
第一击，虽然没用全力，可确确实实没破对方的防。

第二击，用了全力，也只是踢歪了对方的头而已。
两个巨型狼人，估计身体的各项属性，不说百万，起码十万是有的。
这种级别的存在，是他目前碰瓷不了的。
content_en:
After cleaning up the fourth battalion, Cao Bi immediately returned to the west branch of the General Military Mansion and sat there to guard against possible accidents.
After two purge operations, he has realized a problem.
Xu Zongbing and Bian Shen will be more than just followers to him, but more like two efficiency amplifiers.
With the help of their minds and the power in their hands, a lot can be saved.
After putting Scar Girl on the bed and covering her with a quilt, Cao Bi came to the table, poured himself a cup of tea in a leisurely manner, sat down slowly, closed his eyes and savored the tea.
While you're at it, check out the new properties panel.
[Name: Cao Bi]
【Power: 39333.7】
【Speed: 23887.3】
【Physique: 24807.7】
[Perception: 7133.3]
【Spirit: 6707.7】
【Resentment: 601】
【Anger: 312.7】
【Death Qi: 718】
【Eating Soul: 70】
[Obsession: 88]
[Special: Manipulating Earth to Control Stone]
[Special: Licking Flowers and Dragon Tongue Skill]
[Rare: Hammer and Sickle: 1 (unknown countdown)]
"It's so serious to be partial to science!"
"If this trend continues, he will really become a reckless man in the future!"
Cao Bi was filled with emotion when he realized that his strength attribute was the best.
However, there was nothing he could do. After killing people, he tried his best to plunder other attributes.
However, the vast majority of people in this world are also very partial to science.
Generally speaking, the strength is on the upper side, especially for those with vicious bones.
Followed by physique and speed, in the middle.
Finally there is perception and soul, these two are particularly weak.
This is true even for the elite border troops of the special battalion.
Most of the time, the mental value will not exceed one.
Cao Bi didn't know if it was because they visited the brothel too much or if he masturbated too much. Anyway, under Kong Wu's powerful body, his mental strength was terrible.
As for the ordinary refugees, they are even worse. Many of them cannot even reach the standard of strength, let alone perception and spirit.
In order to maintain the maximum cost performance, when all attributes of the killed target are lower than one, Cao Bi will choose perception or spirit without hesitation.
When the target's three attributes of strength, speed, and constitution are much greater than perception and spirit, Cao Bi will give priority to the one with the highest value.
Under this kind of decision-making method, you will unknowingly become a partial subject.
“Be modest and prudent, guard against arrogance and impetuosity!
There is a long road ahead and we need to keep up the good work! "
Looking at the column of strength attributes, the faces of three giant werewolves suddenly appeared in Cao Bi's mind, and his joy was instantly halved.
Recalling his first two strikes, he felt an inexplicable sense of urgency and pressure.
Although the first blow was not full force, it did not break the opponent's defense.
The second blow, with all his strength, just kicked the opponent's head.
The two giant werewolves estimated that their physical attributes were worth at least a hundred thousand, not to mention a million.
An existence of this level is currently beyond his reach.
